final_message: PJR-98G4: implemented per-repository task worktrees (<worktree_base>/<task-id>/project/ and /<repo>/) for projects declaring repos, with removal/discard/orphan detection across repositories, reserved repo name 'project' (config + schema), worktree-aware repos[].path resolution, agent env SPECDOJO_REPO_* and prompt guidance, runner-appended provider extra-root args (claude/codex/antigravity/copilot; opencode unsupported without agent definition change), protected-config/Git-state checks and executor evidence per repository (<repo>:<path>), and a pre-integration guard that blocks tasks with pending product changes until PJR-0WAA. Added unit/integration tests and updated config reference, docs-structure-guide, and the PJR-98G4 ticket. The new tests were not run in the sandbox (left to parent test-unit/test-integration). During development, npx tsc --noEmit (src) and npx eslint on changed src files were also run; they overlap parent typecheck/lint-ts and are not listed as validations.
